generalTab.comment: Settings sidebar row + pane title: the general settings pane.

shortcutOpenSettings.comment: Shortcut-recorder row: the hotkey that opens the settings window on whichever pane it was last left on. Each row is authored whole rather than composed from the setting's own label.

shortcutToggleRomanization.comment: Shortcut-recorder row: the hotkey that switches between the two romanizations. Each row is authored whole rather than composed from the setting's own label, whose wording is a verb phrase in several languages.

values.ja: 入力モードを切り替える

shortcutToggleTranslateSwapped.comment: Shortcut-recorder row: the hotkey that flips which script is committed.

menuFile.comment: Menu-bar File menu title. An LSUIElement process builds its own menu bar so the settings window keeps the standard editing shortcuts.

menuClose.comment: File menu item: close the front window (⌘W).

dictionarySourcesLink.comment: Settings sidebar row + pane title: the dictionary-source toggles page. iOS lists the toggles inline instead.

openURLFailed.comment: Alert title when NSWorkspace could not open a dictionary's web page. macOS-only: the iOS opener is fire-and-forget.

values.ja: ページを開けませんでした

customDictReadFailed.comment: Alert title when the custom-dictionary store could not be read.

values.en: Could Not Read the Custom Dictionary
values.ja: カスタム辞書を読み込めませんでした

customDictWriteFailed.comment: Alert title when a custom-dictionary write failed.

values.en: Could Not Save to the Custom Dictionary
values.ja: カスタム辞書に保存できませんでした

progressSaving.comment: Label under the spinner while a 詞庫 page saves. macOS-only: the mobile apps have no blocking overlay.

progressDeleting.comment: Label under the spinner while a 詞庫 page deletes.

progressExporting.comment: Label under the spinner while a 詞庫 page writes a CSV.

progressImporting.comment: Label under the spinner while a 詞庫 page reads a CSV.

importComplete.comment: Alert title after a CSV import finished. iOS titles the alert with the action's own name instead.

values.ja: 読み込みが完了しました

notUTF8Detail.comment: Alert body when an imported file is not UTF-8 — a different cause from a malformed CSV, which has its own message.

values.hanji: 這个檔案毋是 UTF-8 文字。
values.tailo: tsit ê tóng-àn m̄-sī UTF-8 bûn-jī.
values.poj: chit ê tóng-àn m̄-sī UTF-8 bûn-jī.
values.en: This file is not UTF-8 text.
values.ja: このファイルは UTF-8 テキストではありません。

entriesSection.comment: Section header over the custom-dictionary rows. The shared key is already the page title one line above.

candidateWindowLayout.comment: Picker label in the 一般 pane: which shape the candidate window takes (horizontal row / vertical list / expandable grid).

values.ja: 候補ウィンドウの配置

candidateLayoutHorizontal.comment: Picker value: the horizontal single-row candidate window, paged left to right.

candidateLayoutVertical.comment: Picker value: the vertical scrolling-list candidate window.

candidateLayoutExpandable.comment: Picker value: the expandable candidate window — one row that unfolds into a grid via its chevron.

appearanceTab.comment: Settings sidebar row + pane title: the candidate-window appearance pane (light/dark mode, layout, size, font).

candidateAppearanceLight.comment: Caption under the light-mode thumbnail in the 外觀 pane's appearance selector, mirroring System Settings' Appearance row.

candidateAppearanceDark.comment: Caption under the dark-mode thumbnail in the 外觀 pane's appearance selector, mirroring System Settings' Appearance row.

candidateWindowSize.comment: Picker label: how much air the candidate window puts around its text.

values.ja: 候補ウィンドウの大きさ

sizeSmall.comment: Picker value shared by the candidate window-size and text-size rows: the smallest step.

sizeMedium.comment: Picker value shared by the candidate window-size and text-size rows: the default step, named Standard (USER 2026-08-21).

sizeLarge.comment: Picker value shared by the candidate window-size and text-size rows: the larger step.

shortcutsTab.comment: Sidebar label for the settings pane holding the shortcut rows.

bindingSlotModifier.comment: Picker label: which key set picks a candidate by slot (q w d f z x v y ;, ⌃1-9 or ⌥1-9; ⇧1-9 always pick).

actionNextCandidate.comment: Shortcut row: move the highlight to the next candidate.

actionPreviousCandidate.comment: Shortcut row: move the highlight to the previous candidate.

actionPageForward.comment: Shortcut row: show the next page of candidates.

actionPageBackward.comment: Shortcut row: show the previous page of candidates.

actionConfirmHighlighted.comment: Shortcut row: commit the highlighted candidate.

actionCommitLiteral.comment: Shortcut row: commit the romanization exactly as typed.

actionCommitAlternateScript.comment: Shortcut row: commit the highlighted candidate in the other script (漢羅).

values.ja: もう一方の表記で確定

shortcutUnbound.comment: Shortcut recorder button when no key is assigned to the row.

shortcutRecording.comment: Shortcut recorder button while it is waiting for a key press.

values.ja: キーを押してください…

shortcutRejectedTypingKey.comment: Recorder error: the key pressed is one that types romanization, so it cannot be bound.

values.tailo: tsit ê kiān sī phah-jī iōng ê
values.poj: chit ê kiān sī phah-jī ēng ê
values.ja: そのキーは入力に使います

shortcutRejectedReservedKey.comment: Recorder error: the key pressed is reserved by the input method (arrows, paging, Esc, Delete).

values.tailo: tsit ê kiān su-ji̍p-huat lâu teh iōng
values.poj: chit ê kiān su-ji̍p-hoat lâu teh ēng
values.ja: そのキーは予約済みです

shortcutRejectedNoKey.comment: Recorder error: the event carried no key that could be recorded.

values.ja: 記録できるキーがありません

shortcutRejectedSlotChord.comment: Recorder error: the chord pressed is one of the candidate-slot chords, which are classified before bound actions.

values.en: That is a candidate number key
values.ja: それは候補選択キーです

shortcutRejectedSystemShortcut.comment: Shortcut recorder refusal: the chord is already a system-wide keyboard shortcut, so recording it would give the user a key that never fires.

values.tailo: tse sī hē-thóng ê khuài-sok khí
values.poj: che sī hē-thóng ê khoài-sok khí
values.ja: それはシステムのショートカットです

shortcutRejectedHostShortcut.comment: Shortcut recorder refusal: the chord is a bare Command combination, which belongs to the menus of whatever application the user is typing into.

values.hanji: 這是應用程式的快速齒
values.tailo: tse sī ìng-iōng-tîng-sik ê khuài-sok khí
values.poj: che sī èng-iōng-thêng-sek ê khoài-sok khí
values.en: That belongs to the app you are typing in
values.ja: それは入力先のアプリのショートカットです

copyrightLine.comment: Settings 一般 pane footer: authorship line beside the sponsor link. Same in every language — a personal name carries no translation. The year is a literal, updated by hand at release time.

sponsorLink.comment: Settings 一般 pane footer: link out to the ECPay donation page. The heart is part of the authored label, so each language owns its own placement.

updateCheckNow.comment: Button in the Settings 一般 pane that checks for an update immediately, next to the installed version, and the input-source menu row that does the same.

menuSettings.comment: Input-source menu row that opens the settings window on the pane the user left it on.

updateCurrentVersionLabel.comment: Settings 一般 pane: the installed version, shown beside the check button. Wording mirrors home.json `version`.

updateAvailableTitle.comment: Update alert: title when the manifest names a newer version than the installed one.

values.ja: 新しいバージョンがあります

updateAvailableMessage.comment: The one sentence announcing a downloadable version, on both surfaces that announce it: the manual-check sheet and the system notification. The installed version is not repeated and the reader is not told to click — a notification is what it is (USER 2026-08-28: 用字精簡清楚即可).

values.hanji: 台語齒盤 {latest} 會使下載矣。
values.ja: 台語キーボード {latest} がダウンロードできます。

updateDownloadAction.comment: Update alert: default button — opens the download page in the browser.

updateLaterAction.comment: Update alert: dismisses without recording anything — the next check may notify again.

updateUpToDateTitle.comment: Manual-check alert: the installed version is already the newest published one.

updateCheckFailedTitle.comment: Manual-check alert: the check could not complete. Automatic checks fail silently instead.

values.ja: アップデートを確認できませんでした

updateCheckFailedMessage.comment: Manual-check alert: generic recovery line — no error taxonomy, the user's only remedy is the network and retrying.

values.hanji: 請檢查網路了後才閣試。
values.tailo: tshiánn kiám-tsa bāng-lōo liáu-āu tsiah koh tshì.
values.poj: chhiáⁿ kiám-cha bāng-lō͘ liáu-āu chiah koh chhì.
values.en: Check your network connection and try again.
values.ja: ネットワーク接続を確認してから、もう一度お試しください。

updateNotifyOfferTitle.comment: Title of the one-time offer, shown the first time the settings window opens: may we notify about new versions?

values.hanji: 有新版本的時陣通知你?
values.tailo: Ū sin pán-pún ê sî-tsūn thong-ti lí?
values.poj: Ū sin pán-pún ê sî-chūn thong-ti lí?
values.ja: 新しいバージョンをお知らせしますか？

updateNotifyOfferEnable.comment: Default button of the one-time notification offer; accepting it is what triggers the system permission prompt.

updatePendingVersionLabel.comment: Settings 一般 pane row shown while a newer version is known but not installed. The surface that stays accurate with no network and after a missed notification.

values.ja: バージョン {version} があります

updateNotificationsOffNote.comment: Settings 一般 pane row shown when notifications are refused. Says what turning them on gets you rather than what is currently lost (USER 2026-08-24: 「改為比較正面」), and leads out to where it is changed. The key name still describes when the row appears, not what it says.

values.hanji: 系統通知拍開，才會收著更新通知
values.tailo: Hē-thóng thong-ti phah-khui, tsiah ē siu--tio̍h king-sin thong-ti
values.poj: Hē-thóng thong-ti phah-khui, chiah ē siu--tio̍h keng-sin thong-ti
values.en: Turn on system notifications to receive update notices
values.ja: システム通知をオンにすると、アップデートのお知らせを受け取れます

updateOpenNotificationSettings.comment: Settings 一般 pane link out to the System Settings notifications pane, beside the notifications-off note.

updateDownloadAndInstallAction.comment: Settings 一般 pane: fetches the update package in the app, replacing the trip to the download page. Shown only when the manifest names a package and this build can pin its signer.

values.ja: ダウンロードしてインストール

updateInstallAction.comment: Settings 一般 pane: opens the downloaded package in Installer.app. The user's second press — arrival never launches anything by itself.

updateRetryAction.comment: Settings 一般 pane: tries a failed update download again.

updateDownloadFailedNote.comment: Settings 一般 pane: the update package did not finish downloading. Retryable — the package itself may be fine. Kept to the failure alone; the retry button says what to do, and updateCheckFailedMessage already carries the network advice.

values.ja: ダウンロードが完了しませんでした

updatePackageRejectedNote.comment: Settings 一般 pane: the downloaded package is not this project's signed installer, so it is never offered for installation. Kept to the fact alone — the 去下載 button beside it is what says where to go instead.

values.en: This download could not be verified
values.ja: このダウンロードを検証できませんでした

updateInstallerOpenFailedNote.comment: Settings 一般 pane: the verified package is staged but Installer.app would not open. Retryable; wording mirrors openURLFailed.

values.ja: インストーラを開けませんでした

clearLearningRecords.comment: Destructive row in the 詞庫 pane: deletes the frequency AND association records in one go. Acts on click, with no confirmation (USER 2026-08-25). macOS has no per-record management UI, so this is the only way to discard what the keyboard learned.

clearLearningRecordsDone.comment: Alert title after the 刪除學習紀錄 row finishes.

values.ja: 学習記録を消去しました

clearLearningRecordsFailed.comment: Alert title when 刪除學習紀錄 could not empty a table. The store's own diagnostic follows as the body.

values.ja: 学習記録を消去できませんでした
